title: Collapse of white dwarfs above the Chandrasekhar mass
summary: We give a dynamical characterization of the Chandrasekhar mass for cold white dwarfs governed by the radial Euler--Poisson equations with the exact Chandrasekhar equation of state. This mass is the infimum of masses for which a finite-energy classical solution with a physical vacuum can contract its entire support to a point in finite time. Below it, conservation of energy prevents complete collapse.
